visualReview.scope: Portable rendering and geometry presentation; not maximum exterior fidelity approval.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all eleven final portable frames in the labeled contact sheet. Roof-course gaps were closed, obstructed window recesses opened, duplicated pinnacles removed and Gothic molding rebuilt as continuous nested profiles. Gable backs and buttress returns were closed after the high and oblique views exposed open surfaces. The final tower, open portal/gallery, terrace and stair silhouette remain visible from the four turntable directions and six close/far cameras. Fine architectural and sculpture correspondence remains pending.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all ten final shared frames in the contact sheet and full-size upper-gallery, memorial-portal and brick-roof views. Five canonical graphs resolve at metric UV scale, all 296070 triangles load, no private bitmap is required, and unload passes. Brick and stone tone still require facade fidelity comparison. This fixture is isolated asset review, not a real geographic placement.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID way/23722446 supplies the mapped terrace anchor and undirected square axes. Signed facade facing, actual stair extent, sloping ground and height datum remain to be reviewed; no placement was activated.

fidelityReview.notes: The architectural draft follows the 1899 section/elevation and documented 55 m / 36 m heights. It still lacks the memorial statue, heraldic eagle relief, bronze medallions and mosaic vault. Terrace side stairs, historic tracery/profile details, facade tones and present roof equipment need additional source-backed work. These omissions prohibit a completed-model claim.
